title: BusKarro Bus Reservation System
description: A scalable Django and DRF backend with custom JWT authentication, REST APIs, and email based ticket confirmation. Includes admin and user dashboards with real time ticketing, deployed on Render with a dark and light mode toggle.

title: Talking Meow Chat App
description: A Django based real time chat system with secure sessions, dynamic message rendering, and a responsive interface. Integrated Redis and a WebSocket ready backend with session middleware, deployed on Render.

title: Yatri Bandhu Custom Bot
description: A custom chatbot built with Python and API integrations for real time communication and automated ticket handling. Implements AI driven workflows with triggers, webhooks, and escalation logic to streamline support.

title: YouTube UI Clone
description: A responsive frontend clone of the YouTube interface, focused on layout accuracy and clean component structure.

title: Vehicle Insurance MLOps Pipeline
description: An end to end MLOps pipeline for a vehicle insurance prediction model, covering data ingestion, training, and deployment steps.

title: Diabetes Prediction Model
description: A machine learning model trained to predict diabetes risk from patient health data.
